codename: The System Initialization & Audio Safety Update
title: System Initialization, Audio Safety & Consistency Fixes
summary: This release focuses on standardizing the codebase, resolving critical Qt initialization bugs, and expanding the centralized sound management system with strict thread safety.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Added new default system sounds to sound_manager.py, including a dedicated Shutdown sound effect.
Introduced the GlobalSystemSounds configuration setting to allow centralized control over system-wide auditory feedback.
Implemented Persistent Login Profiles across all boxes within the Social Tab to retain user session data between reboots.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Refactored ear_core.py to strictly utilize the Sound Manager via Qt Signals, guaranteeing crash-free background audio execution.
Fully updated README.md to document all newly integrated features and architectural changes up to version 1.1.7.1.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Resolved premature app=QApplication instantiation in both Visar Chat Core and Visar Main to prevent early rendering crashes.
Patched a critical Version Mismatch Error by sweeping the codebase to uniformly update legacy v1.0 references to the v1.1 architecture.
Updated the news toast parent reference to .window() inside news_delta_engine.py to ensure correct Z-index rendering and UI hierarchy.

notes: Version 1.1.7.1 provides essential stability improvements, specifically targeting thread safety in audio processing and resolving early rendering crashes to ensure a robust foundation for future features.
